en.title: Minimum Shipments for Items at Different Locations
en.description:
One shipment can send two items from different locations, or a single item on its own. Find the minimum number of shipments needed to send all items.

The standard I/O, examples, and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's are not presented as original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n locations (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: the two 7s are paired with 1 and 8 respectively, and 6 is shipped alone, for 3 in total. Example 2: items from the same location cannot ship together, so 3 shipments are needed. Example 3: the two locations ship together, 1 shipment.
hints: Let the most frequent location occur f times; the answer is max(f,⌈n/2⌉).
